accepted_residuals: Replacing an exception class's __module__ with a distinct string retains the old native name buffer; assigning the same name reuses it.
MappingProxyType equality with a custom reflected object does not delegate as CPython does and remains a documented deviation.

observed_compatibility_changes: types.MappingProxyType now supplies a live read-only mapping view with opaque backing storage for the tested surface.
Runtime-length tuple concatenation and += compile for compatible item types, including fixed tuples and optional-None widening.
Opt-in dynamic Any tuples convert item by item while preserving tuple identity and aliases in the retained cases.
GenericAlias class subscripts work in annotations, including re.Pattern[str] and re.Match[str].
Class/subclass unions, including nested union aliases, prune to the base class.
Exception classes accept string __module__ assignment while explicitly declared non-string fields retain ordinary class-variable behavior.
